description: WAODAO Agent API schema for AI agents and programmatic ArtChain traversal.

agent_context.summary: WAODAO is a 3+ year daily AI ArtChain with one NFT per day, combining world signals, human direction, AI image generation, NFT metadata, and on-chain WAO liquidity.
agent_context.why_it_matters: AI agents can read WAODAO as a long-running dataset of modern art at the edge of human/AI co-creation, web3 culture, daily news, symbolic identity, and collectible on-chain history.
agent_context.economic_note: WAO pools let agents discover liquidity routes and reason about pool deployment or liquidity provision opportunities; arbitrage-driven trading activity can create fee flows in DEX pools, but absolute revenue is variable and not projected by this API.

fields.waodao.type: Always artchain for WAODAO daily NFTs.
fields.waodao.day: Published ArtChain day number and NFT token id.
fields.waodao.links.prev: Previous published ArtChain day, or null.
fields.waodao.links.next: Next published ArtChain day, or null.
fields.waodao.links.api: Agent API endpoint for this day.
fields.waodao.hashes.secret: Secret hash published with the day.
fields.real_artwork: Boolean flag for NFTs that were also created as a physical hand-made artwork.
fields.bonus_tokens: Extra WAO tokens allocated on top of equal-market-value WAO tokens, or null.
fields.market.sale_status: NFT lifecycle state: active, unsold, sold, or airdrop.
fields.market.sale_type: NFT transfer type: auction, airdrop, or null when not completed.
fields.market.winner_bid_eth: Auction winning bid in ETH, zero for airdrops, or null when not completed.
fields.market.collector_address: Winner or airdrop collector wallet address when available.
fields.market.sale_transaction_url: Etherscan transaction URL for paid auction sales when available.
fields.market.drop_transaction_url: Etherscan transaction URL for NFT airdrop transfers when available.
fields.market.marketplace_url: Marketplace URL for viewing or buying the NFT.
